invariants.rationale: Method calls are made on writeClient, so it must not be null.
instantTime is used as an argument to writeClient methods, so it cannot be null.
preppedRecordInputs must not be null as it is passed to upsertPreppedRecords.
The upsertPreppedRecords call is assigned to a local; a null result would likely indicate error.
The size of the write status list should be non-negative.
